data.narrative:
Until, a Series A biotech & health company founded by Laura Deming and Hunter Davis, has raised $106M to date. The valuation landscape includes 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the sector, though a sufficiently tight comparable set at matching stage and valuation tier could not be established.

Only one valuation method proved applicable: stage-progression analysis. Using total capital raised ($106M) as a proxy for post-money valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $212M. This represents the central estimate given the constraints of available data. The peer-median method could not be deployed due to insufficient narrow-stage comparable datapoints (fewer than 3 same-stage or adjacent-stage biotech peers meeting additional filters). Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples (sector median 6.6x across the 3 public tickers) could not be applied in the absence of Until's disclosed revenue.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $180M to $244M, centered at $212M, though this range rests on a single method and should be treated with corresponding uncertainty. Key limitations include the absence of tighter private peer data at matching stage, lack of target revenue disclosure, and limited public comp coverage in this subsector. Additional diligence on comparable financials and market positioning would materially sharpen precision.
